People.want: Wants to sign the insurance contract today
People.role: Customer waiting with the agency representative to sign the contract

People.want: Wants the locked CCC Agency Portal account unlocked immediately to proceed with the client's contract today
People.role: Representative of BBB Agency contacting support to resolve an account lock and continue the contract process

People.want: Wants to verify identity per security policy and unlock the account securely
People.role: AAA Insurance support desk operator who authenticates and unlocks accounts

Issue.title: Want to sign the insurance contract today
Issue.description: The customer is present and wants to sign immediately, and the agency representative wants to close the deal today

Issue.title: Cannot log in to the CCC Agency Portal due to account lock
Issue.description: When attempting to log in, the agency representative received an 'account is locked' message and requested immediate unlocking to proceed with the client

Issue.title: Cannot answer the registered secret question for identity verification
Issue.description: The agency representative does not remember the answer to the secret question required for unlocking over the phone and asks for another verification method

Solution.title: Use app-based login approval for identity verification
Solution.description: The operator sends a 'Login Approval' push notification to the AAA Insurance official smartphone app; the agency representative taps 'Approve', after which the operator verifies the identity, unlocks the account, and resets the password
